_doc: Presentation figures of the world view (game/ only, no rule reads them): zoom, camera, day/night, timings and the colours of the marks drawn by code (signs, doors, badges, bars). The look of each thing (greybox colours, heights, kit) lives in its scene in game/visuals/ (docs/protocolos/editar-a-mano.md). GDD 4.15 gives the day/night colours. zoom_levels: only values that keep pixels whole (D2). tint_strength: how far the phase colour pulls from white (1 = the raw colour, too dark for #1A1A40 at night). transition_minutes: game minutes a phase takes to blend in from the previous one.

character._doc: width: the click area of a walker (its height is the Top marker of its scene). outline: the badge's border when it does not work for the player. H4: employees carry a diamond over the head in the colour of the family they work for; gold border (badge_own_border) when it is the player's family.

buildings._doc: Marks of the buildings of state.buildings on the map (by type): sign and door colours. H4: sign_mode = "hover" shows the sign only while the mouse is over the building or it is picked (the houses: the town is not full of signs). The building itself is game/visuals/buildings/<type>.tscn.

services._doc: H3 marks of the market stalls and the contract board on the map: sign colours (the stalls and the board are game/visuals/props/stall_<id>.tscn and board.tscn).

notices._doc: H3: urgent notices pop up over the HUD for popup_seconds (at most popup_max at once); severity colours of the notices log.

new_game._doc: H3 new game screen (GDD 4.16): the start offered (data/starts/) and the family colours to pick from (4.10.9; provisional palette from the style bible's base tones).

interior._doc: H2 interior (GDD 4.6.4): zoom, camera offset, fade (in+out, seconds), the colours of the station marks (busy, progress, master-touch window) and its blink. The room, its stations and its colours are game/visuals/interiors/<type>.tscn.

upgrades._doc: H5 upgrade tree (GDD 4.8): latest_only_branches = branches whose visuals replace each other (only the highest finished level is shown; the rest show every finished level). status colours of the tree panel's cells (owned, in_works, available, blocked). works: the bar over a building under construction on the map (back, fill, text) and the panel's bar. The scaffold itself is the node Works of game/visuals/buildings/<type>.tscn.
